1. **webviews/components/timeline.tsx — merge commits still untouched.** The PR description and title claim both regular commits and merge commits are fixed, but the diff only rewrites `CommitEventView`; no `MergedEvent`/merge-commit view is touched. Clicking a merge commit link in the timeline will still open the browser, so the fix is incomplete relative to its own stated scope (and likely relative to issue #7183). Either update the merge-commit rendering with the same interception or correct the PR description to not claim this.

2. **webviews/components/timeline.tsx — no fallback when local diff fails.** `href` is set to `undefined` whenever `pr.isCurrentlyCheckedOut`, and the click is fully `preventDefault()`-ed. If `PullRequestModel.openCommitChanges` fails (e.g. the commit isn't fetched locally, or is a shallow/rebased ref), the user gets only an error toast with no way to reach the commit at all — previously this path always worked via the browser link. Keep `href` pointing at `event.htmlUrl` and only intercept the click, or explicitly fall back to opening the browser URL when the extension-side command reports failure.

3. **src/github/pullRequestModel.ts, `openCommitChanges` DELETE branch.** For deleted files the resource URI is built as `vscode.Uri.file(path.resolve(repository.rootUri.fsPath, change.uri.fsPath))` — a plain working-tree file URI — while every other branch (ADD/RENAME/MODIFY) uses a `toReviewUri` keyed to the commit. This is inconsistent and can show the current on-disk file (if one happens to exist at that path) instead of the commit's deleted-file state. Build a review URI for the deleted file consistent with the other branches.

4. **src/github/pullRequestModel.ts + src/github/pullRequestOverview.ts — redundant/dead error handling.** `PullRequestModel.openCommitChanges` already catches every error internally and shows its own `showErrorMessage`, so it never throws. The `catch` block added in `PullRequestOverviewPanel.openCommitChanges` (with `Logger.error` + a second error message) can therefore never run. Pick one layer to own error handling — let the model method rethrow and handle/log once at the panel, or drop the outer try/catch.

5. **src/github/pullRequestModel.ts — no handling for a root commit.** `repository.diffBetween(commitSha + '~1', commitSha)` will fail for a commit with no parent, surfacing only the generic "Failed to open commit changes" message. Given PR history can include a repo's initial commit, this should be special-cased (diff against the empty tree) or at least given a clearer message.

6. **Test coverage missing.** The PR adds non-trivial branching logic (ADD/DELETE/RENAME/MODIFY → URI pair construction) with no unit tests, despite the repo having existing test infrastructure around `pullRequestModel`. "Testing" in the description is manual-only. Add tests covering each `GitChangeType` branch of `openCommitChanges`.

7. **PR description inaccuracy.** The description advertises "Robust extraction of commit SHAs from GitHub URLs using regex pattern," but the shipped frontend code simply passes the already-known `event.sha` — no URL parsing exists in the diff. Either this logic is missing or the description misrepresents the implementation; align the description with the actual code before merge.
